notes: לָכֵן is treated as a rule 30 fusion across its two segmented morphemes rather than one rendered morpheme beside an unrepresented one; source head on the morpheme carrying the לָכֵן lemma.

The suffix on the infinitive construct תִּתְּךָ takes the subject pronoun 'thou' while the infinitive keeps 'hast set' (rule 18); the object marker is unrepresented, the ASV writing the object bare (rule 16).
